source: ComicsBox USA series pages and first Italian publication links
rules: A physical Italian album keeps one global ID even when it appears in multiple paths.
Physical and digital ownership belong to the Italian album; read state belongs to the path.
Each path step selects one or more USA contents from the physical album.
Archive is a role of a reading path, never an attribute that changes the identity of an album.
Missing first Italian publications remain declared audit gaps and are never replaced with synthetic issues.
